source_facts.fact: All segments are sorted unique; canonical is only the lexicographically first alias label, not native parent/top designation; visited prevents reprocessing aliases within candidate.

After segment export and before first endpoint row: get_pins leaf(all segments), get_ports(all segments), get_cells and ensure_cells, then four pin property columns. Partial-file silence cannot identify which call is active.

documented_facts.text: parent_net selects the segment connected to driver leaf pin
top_net selects top segment; segments returns every segment across all hierarchy levels
leaf includes primitive or black box pins; of_objects returns pins connected to specified net; no explicit any-segment/full-hierarchy equivalence statement
Ports are separately queried for connected nets; no permission to replace their all-segment scope.
IS_LEAF property exists in example; documentation lacks an explicit equivalence theorem for filter(IS_LEAF) and get_pins -leaf across all hierarchy/black-box cases.
Fanout network traversal/timing endpoints differs from complete same-electrical-net connected pins.
FLAT_PIN_COUNT example property exists; a count cannot establish NAME/direction/kind equality.

decision: Preserve b59 E008 sources and current R004 native run. No EDA, native query, additional graph scan, process/lock control, or cutoff introduced.
